title: Aylin's Day
text:
Aylin is twenty-four years old. She is from Izmir, but now she lives in Istanbul. She works in a small office near the sea.

Every morning, Aylin gets up at seven o'clock. She has breakfast with her sister. They usually eat bread, cheese and olives, and they drink tea. Then Aylin takes the bus to work. The bus is often full, so she listens to music.

She starts work at nine. She answers emails and talks to customers on the phone. At one o'clock, she has lunch with her colleagues. In the evening, she goes home, cooks dinner and watches a film. She goes to bed at eleven.

questions.explain_tr: "She is from Izmir, but now she lives in Istanbul."

questions.q: What time does she start work?
Why does she listen to music on the bus?
options: Because she works in a music shop.
Because the bus is full and she can't sit or do much.
